CHARTER AMENDMENT COMMITTEE AGENDA
  TUESDAY, JULY 16, 2024
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 4:00 PM

Mayor Rex Richardson, Chair
All Members of City Council

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT ONLINE PUBLIC COMMENTS
  AND EMAIL COMMENTS TO CITYCLERK@LONGBEACH.GOV

  PLEASE VIEW THE MEETING FROM YOUR COMPUTER, TABLET, OR SMARTPHONE
  VIA: HTTPS://LONGBEACH.PRIMEGOV.COM/PUBLIC/PORTAL?FROMIFRAME=TRUE

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

HEARING

1.  24-54165  Recommendation to conduct the second hearing of the Charter Amendment
  Committee, to receive and file comments from the community and receive and file
  supporting documentation into the record regarding the proposed amendment of
  City Charter Article XI (Civil Service Department) to combine the Civil Service and
  Human Resources Departments into one unified hiring department to manage all
  employee recruitment, hiring, and classified employee certifications; establish an
  independent Civil Service Employee Rights and Appeals Commission to resolve
  complaints regarding Civil Service rules, to adjudicate classified employee
  disciplinary appeal; and to implement classified hiring preferences for Long Beach
  residents, students from local colleges and universities, current employees, and
  certain internships/apprenticeships; and refer to the City Council to consider
  adoption of all required resolutions to place the Charter amendment on the
  November 5, 2024, General Election Ballot. (Citywide)

  Office or Department:  City Manager

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  24-54166  Recommendation to receive and file comments from the community, receive and
  file supporting documentation into the record regarding the proposed amendment to
  Long Beach City Charter Article V (Officers and Employees) to modify the length of
  terms for Harbor and Public Utilities Commissioners to four (4) years; and Article XII
  (Harbor Department) to modify the powers and duties of the Harbor Commission
  and annual budget timeline, and refer to the City Council to consider adoption of all
  required resolutions to place the Charter amendment on the November 5, 2024,

minutes_text:
CHARTER AMENDMENT COMMITTEE MINUTES
  TUESDAY, JULY 16, 2024
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 4:00 PM

Mayor Rex Richardson, Chair
All Members of City Council

  FINISHED AGENDA & DRAFT MINUTES

CALL TO ORDER

At 4:35 PM, Councilman Austin called the meeting to order.

ROLL CALL

Councilmembers Present: Zendejas, Allen, Duggan, Supernaw, Kerr, Saro, Uranga, Austin,
Ricks-Oddie

Also present: Thomas Modica, City Manager, April Walker, Assistant City Manager, Gary Anderson,
Assistant City Attorney, Jonathan Nagayama, City Clerk Analyst.

HEARING

1.  24-54165  Recommendation to conduct the second hearing of the Charter Amendment
  Committee, to receive and file comments from the community and receive and file
  supporting documentation into the record regarding the proposed amendment of
  City Charter Article XI (Civil Service Department) to combine the Civil Service and
  Human Resources Departments into one unified hiring department to manage all
  employee recruitment, hiring, and classified employee certifications; establish an
  independent Civil Service Employee Rights and Appeals Commission to resolve
  complaints regarding Civil Service rules, to adjudicate classified employee
  disciplinary appeal; and to implement classified hiring preferences for Long Beach
  residents, students from local colleges and universities, current employees, and
  certain internships/apprenticeships; and refer to the City Council to consider
  adoption of all required resolutions to place the Charter amendment on the
  November 5, 2024, General Election Ballot. (Citywide)

  A motion was made by Member Ricks-Oddie, seconded by Member Saro, to
  approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  8 Zendejas, Duggan, Supernaw, Kerr, Saro, Uranga, Austin, Ricks-
  Oddie
  No:  0 None
  Recused: 0 None

  Page 1 of 2

  Phyllis Arias spoke.

  Donte Woods spoke.

  Robert Lee Hickson IV spoke.

  Christina Hall spoke.

2.  24-54166  Recommendation to receive and file comments from the community, receive and
  file supporting documentation into the record regarding the proposed amendment
  to Long Beach City Charter Article V (Officers and Employees) to modify the length
  of terms for Harbor and Public Utilities Commissioners to four (4) years; and Article
  XII (Harbor Department) to modify the powers and duties of the Harbor
  Commission and annual budget timeline, and refer to the City Council to consider
  adoption of all required resolutions to place the Charter amendment on the
  November 5, 2024, General Election Ballot.

  A motion was made by Member Duggan, seconded by Member Kerr, to
  approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  8 Zendejas, Duggan, Supernaw, Kerr, Saro, Uranga, Austin, Ricks-
  Oddie
  No:  0 None
  Recused: 0 None
  Absent: 1 Allen

  Thomas Modica, City Manager, spoke.

PUBLIC COMMENT

There was one Online Public Comment and no non-agenda public comment emails received.

ADJOURNMENT

At 5:03 PM, there being no objection, Mayor Richardson declared the meeting adjourned.
